title: Job Applications and Skills
summary: Applications, job motivation, qualifications, and professional presentation.
whyItMatters: Application language helps you understand vacancies, present relevant experience, and connect your qualifications to an employer's needs.

mentalModel.title: Read from requirement to evidence
mentalModel.content: For every requirement in a vacancy, identify one qualification, example, or result that proves your fit.

mentalModel.title: Separate documents and functions
mentalModel.content: The CV records facts, the cover letter explains motivation, and the interview develops both through examples.

ruleBlocks.title: Decode the vacancy
ruleBlocks.content: Mark tasks, required qualifications, preferred skills, working conditions, and the application deadline.

ruleBlocks.title: Match each document to its purpose
ruleBlocks.content: Use Lebenslauf for structured experience, Anschreiben for motivation, and Zeugnisse for evidence.

ruleBlocks.title: Support strengths with examples
ruleBlocks.content: Replace unsupported labels with a situation, action, and result.

ruleBlocks.title: Use professional but direct language
ruleBlocks.content: Prefer precise verbs such as koordinieren, betreuen, entwickeln, and verantworten.

tables.title: Application Vocabulary
rows: die Stelle, die Aufgabe, die Voraussetzung

tables.title: From Claim to Evidence
rows: Ich habe ein Projekt mit fünf Beteiligten koordiniert.
Im Praktikum habe ich täglich mit drei Abteilungen zusammengearbeitet.
Ich habe mich in zwei Wochen in ein neues Programm eingearbeitet.

sentenceStructure: Lead with the most relevant qualification.
Use past tenses for completed experience and present tense for current strengths.

comparisons.summary: Relative reference helps connect broad requirements, workplaces, and previous statements.
The communication lesson turns application vocabulary into persuasive interview answers.

examples.de: Die Stelle erfordert Erfahrung im Kundenkontakt und gute Computerkenntnisse.
examples.en: The position requires customer-contact experience and good computer skills.

examples.de: Ich bewerbe mich um die Stelle als Projektassistenz.
examples.en: I am applying for the project-assistant position.

examples.de: Während meines Praktikums habe ich Veranstaltungen organisiert.
examples.en: During my internship, I organized events.

examples.de: Meine Stärke ist, auch unter Zeitdruck strukturiert zu arbeiten.
examples.en: My strength is working systematically even under time pressure.

examples.de: Meinen Lebenslauf und die Zeugnisse finden Sie im Anhang.
examples.en: You will find my CV and certificates attached.

commonMistakes.wrong: Ich bin perfekt für die Stelle.
commonMistakes.correct: Name relevant skills and prove them with examples.
commonMistakes.reason: Evidence is more persuasive than a broad claim.

commonMistakes.correct: Ich bewerbe mich um die Stelle.
commonMistakes.reason: The verb is reflexive and uses 'um'.

commonMistakes.wrong: Send the same text for every vacancy.
commonMistakes.correct: Connect experience explicitly to the advertised tasks.

tips: Underline matching words in the vacancy and your evidence.
Read the final application for consistent dates and terminology.
